candidate_sentence_map.S1: Infortar Group’s unaudited 2025 results showed stronger operating performance but lower net profit than in 2024, when the initial consolidation of Tallink generated significant one-off effects.

candidate_sentence_map.S7: The report attributes the year-on-year decline in net profit mainly to one-off effects associated with Tallink’s initial consolidation in 2024.

candidate_sentence_map.S10: Operating profit improved from a EUR 6.792 million loss to a EUR 19.842 million profit, and net profit rose from a EUR 11.988 million loss to EUR 14.141 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The EBITDA improvement reflected stronger segment performance, although total financial income and expenses declined to a EUR 8.513 million expense from income of EUR 3.452 million in Q4 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Energy was the largest contributor to full-year revenue and EBITDA.

candidate_sentence_map.S14: In Q4, Elenger’s gas and electricity sales volumes increased 7% to 4.8 TWh despite a 2% decline in regional natural-gas consumption.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Maritime transport generated full-year revenue of EUR 765.288 million and EBITDA of EUR 124.187 million, below 2024 levels of EUR 785.822 million and EUR 175.181 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Tallink carried 5.531 million passengers during the year, down 0.9%, while cargo units fell 19.2%.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: In Q4, maritime revenue increased 2.4% to EUR 188.0 million and net profit was EUR 12.2 million, compared with a loss of EUR 5.2 million a year earlier.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Results were affected by low consumer and business confidence, geopolitical tensions, the sale of the cargo vessel Sailor, and lower financing repayments and interest expense.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: The balance sheet strengthened: total equity rose to EUR 1.178 billion, the equity ratio to 45.5%, and net debt fell to EUR 840.682 million from EUR 1.056 billion.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Cash increased to EUR 219.771 million, while operating cash flow reached EUR 388.632 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Key developments included the acquisition of Oisu Biogaas, continued Rail Baltica and Depo construction, a multi-year agreement for 12 LNG cargoes, and the extension of Silja Europa’s charter agreement to January 2027.
